title: README and tutorial start from incompatible projects
observed: README says to run `./tao create "A reading list"`, which writes a multi-file starter with its own project; the tutorial expects one file whose project id is "reading-list".
impact: A newcomer cannot tell whether to paste tutorial step 1 into the generated starter, where it conflicts, or somewhere else.
expected: The front door and the tutorial name one consistent starting project.
recheck: Follow README then the tutorial from a clean directory.
